summary: DEFSEC Technologies filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, attaching a May 6, 2026 news release announcing the commercial release of its Lightning real-time situational awareness system. No special situation event is described; the filing is a routine current report of a product launch by a foreign private issuer. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. The filing does not meet any special situations category.
